summary: Juan Ciscomani voted Yea on H.R. 6090 and was listed as a sponsor or cosponsor on H.R. 1007, both versions of the Antisemitism Awareness Act embedding the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement. His legislative backing for the IHRA framework and his placement by a pro-Palestine rating organization reflect a posture equating criticism of Israel with antisemitism in education.
